name: canva
longDescription: Ask your chats to find, describe and organise the designs in the Canva account you sign in to.

actions.label: Search Canva designs
actions.description: Finds designs in your Canva account by name or keyword.

actions.label: Read a Canva design
actions.description: Reads one design's title, pages and thumbnail.

actions.label: Read a Canva design's text
actions.description: Reads the text and elements inside one design.

actions.label: Export a Canva design
actions.description: Exports a design as a PDF, image or video file.

actions.label: Comment on a Canva design
actions.description: Leaves a comment on one design for your team.
